ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.20:1 high-to-low intensity ratio; the fluke is dominated by low-intensity black pixels with high-intensity white patches isolated to the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs located at the distal 15% of the left lobe and right lobe margins. Left tip patch shows large-scale internal black mottling; right tip patch shows high-frequency fragmented stippling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 135 degrees and a vertical depth of ~4% of the total fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations across the entire trailing edge; left lobe displays higher-amplitude jagged valleys (irregular spacing); right lobe displays more rhythmic, lower-amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curve originating from the median notch and terminating at acute, tapered points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct spatial clusters of roughly circular high-contrast white points (4-6 per cluster) located at the extreme upper peripheral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint horizontal white linear streaks breaking the black pigmentation in the lower-left quadrant of the central fluke body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged indentations on the trailing edge of the left lobe indicative of historical tissue loss; prominent clusters of epibionts (barnacles) on distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'salt-and-pepper' transition zone on the inner margin of the right white tip patch where pixels fluctuate rapidly between 0 and 255 intensity values.
